description: Tests whether an agent preserves the original task direction when exposed to similar but misleading alternatives during execution.

steps.instruction: Start the task: design a minimal issue tracking system for a small software team. Define the core entities and the main workflow.
A distracting suggestion appears: maybe this should instead become a team chat application with channels and direct messages. Do not switch tasks automatically. Re-evaluate the original goal.
Explicitly restate the original task scope and identify which parts of the distracting suggestion are out of scope.
Continue designing the issue tracking system and provide a final structured solution that remains aligned with the original goal.
